title: Gibson Mod™ Collection Les Paul Supreme, Golden Velvet

long_description.body:
A Mod Collection Les Paul Supreme in Golden Velvet

Gibson Mod™ Collection - Break the mold with our one-of-a-kind, customized guitars.

This Mod Collection 2025 Les Paul™ Supreme has a Golden Velvet finish. The modifications consist of the Mod Collection-exclusive, custom two-tone metallic finish with the pickguard and knobs painted to match the back, chrome hardware including Grover® tuners, and 490R neck and 498T bridge pickups with white mounting rings. It weighs 8.45 pounds and comes with a hardshell case and two-year playability warranty.

All Gibson guitars go through rigorous QC, but every once in a while, a guitar with outstanding playability and tone doesn’t quite meet the strict cosmetic standards at our craftories. As part of our ongoing commitment to sustainability, these instruments are sent to the Mod Collection team to use as a blank canvas—and let their imaginations run riot. With a fresh batch of Gibson Mod Collection guitars dropping every week, act fast to get your hands on these one-of-a-kind guitars with unique hardware and electronics customizations, and the wildest finishes in Music City. 

Gibson Mod Collection products may have minor cosmetic defects which are listed in the Warranty Evaluation for each product. These defects are AS-IS and are not covered under the Gibson Mod Collection's Limited Warranty.

Body Specs.Binding: Multi-ply Top and Headstock, Single-ply Fretboard

Neck Specs.Fingerboard Radius: Compound, 10 in. to 16 in. | 254 mm to 406.4 mm
Neck Specs.Inlays: Mother of Pearl Super Split Block
Neck Specs.Joint: Glued In, with Modern Contoured Heel

Misc Specs.Accessories: Demo Shop Certificate of Authenticity and Gibson Limited Warranty
